comment: No sql: permissions — all SQL lives in Rust behind typed commands (ADR-0002). The plugin is present only for its migration runner. dialog:allow-save opens the native Save as… box for the xlsx export and dialog:allow-open picks the backup folder; both return a path, not a file handle — Rust writes the bytes. No autostart: permissions either: the checkbox goes through update_settings so the registry and the settings row are written together.
